tools.name: bar_grating_load_calculator
tools.description: Finds the lightest welded steel bearing bar (19-W-4 or 15-W-4, smooth or serrated) that carries a clear span and load within a deflection limit.

tools.name: bar_grating_load_tables
tools.description: Looks up the safe uniform load (U), safe concentrated load (C), deflections and weight for welded steel bar grating by bearing bar size and span.

tools.name: aluminum_stainless_bar_grating_load_calculator
tools.description: Safe load, deflection and the lightest bearing bar for aluminum 6063-T6 and stainless 304, 316, 304L and 316L bar grating at 1-3/16 in bar centres.

tools.name: accessible_grating_opening_checker
tools.description: Checks the clear opening between bearing bars against the Ontario Building Code 13 mm limit for barrier-free paths of travel, and the widest bar spacing that would pass.

tools.name: galvanizing_coating_thickness_calculator
tools.description: Minimum average hot-dip galvanized coating grade by steel category and thickness, in mils, microns and ounces of zinc per square foot, with total zinc for a surface area.

tools.name: guard_and_railing_code_checker_ontario
tools.description: Whether a guard is required, its minimum height, opening limit, climbing rule and design loads under the Ontario Building Code Part 9 and Part 3 for a described situation.

tools.name: steel_stair_calculator_ontario
tools.description: Allowed riser counts, riser height, tread run, flights, width, headroom and handrail height for a total rise under Ontario Building Code Part 9.

tools.name: steel_weight_calculator
tools.description: Theoretical weight of carbon steel plate, flat bar, round bar, square bar, angle, square or rectangular tube and round pipe, in pounds and kilograms.

tools.name: trench_drain_grate_load_class
tools.description: The EN 1433 load class, A 15 to F 900, and its test load in kN for where a trench drain goes and what drives or rolls over it.

tools.name: bollard_spacing_and_footing_calculator
tools.description: Counts the bollards for a frontage and clear gap, checks the gap against vehicle and wheelchair guidance, gives typical footing and concrete for a standard (not crash rated) steel pipe bollard, and explains crash ratings.

tools.name: steel_beam_lintel_span_check
tools.description: The steel angle lintel or steel beam that the 2024 Ontario Building Code Part 9 tables list for an opening width in a brick or stone veneer wall or a masonry wall, with the 150 mm bearing rule. Not a stamped design.

tools.name: catch_basin_grate_and_frame_size_finder
tools.description: Names the Ontario Provincial Standard Drawing for a catch basin inlet type, checks the grate bearing on the frame ledge against the NAAMM minimum, gives the range of bearing bar lengths that sit on the ledge, and lists the EN 1433 load class for the traffic.

tools.name: fence_and_gate_post_spacing_and_weight
tools.description: Post count and spacing for a chain link or ornamental steel fence run, chain link footing depth and gate post size, and the weight and hinge loads of an ornamental steel gate leaf.

tools.name: trench_drain_flow_capacity_calculator
tools.description: The flow a trench drain has to handle from a paved area (rational method with Toronto City rainfall rates from Environment and Climate Change Canada) and the flow the channel carries (Manning), with the narrowest channel that works.

tools.name: loading_dock_height_and_leveler_check
tools.description: The grade a dock leveler works at between the lowest and highest truck bed you serve, against the 10% (electric) and 15% (gas or diesel) limits, the shortest standard leveler length that fits, and whether two makers published working ranges cover it.
